page_title: HEI 1-1 MAI | Heidenheim v Mainz 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+4' The attendance for today's match is 15000.
90+4' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
88' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Jessic Ngankam (Mainz) replaces Jae-Sung Lee.
85' Substitution. Tim Kleindienst makes his way off the pitch and Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) comes on as his replacement.
84' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
84' None of the Mainz players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
82' A quickly taken corner by Heidenheim.
81' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
80' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Kevin Sessa will be replaced by Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
77' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
76' Lovely run from Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
75' Edimilson Fernandes goes off the pitch and Nelson Weiper (Mainz) comes on.
73' Heidenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
72' Substitution. Danny da Costa (Mainz) on for Silvan Widmer.
71' Bo Henriksen has decided to substitute Ludovic Ajorque and he is replaced by Tom Krauss (Mainz).

70' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the right post.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) was quite harsh and Sven Jablonski didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Substitution. Marvin Pieringer makes way for Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim).
67' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
65' 1 - 1 Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
61' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Robin Zentner makes a comfortable save.
59' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle after Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
58' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
57' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends a direct effort from the free kick. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's goalkeeper makes a comfortable save to keep the ball from hitting the net.

57' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Robin Zentner to get hold of the ball.
53' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Zentner (Mainz).
53' Heidenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

52' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Heidenheim.
51' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

49' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Kevin Muller is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Sven Jablonski blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
42' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
37' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Anthony Caci plays it into the box, and Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
36' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
35' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
33' Good play from Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.

29' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
29' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
27' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
23' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
22' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
14' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
14' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Heidenheim have a corner.
13' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

11' A nice pass finds Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Robin Zentner pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
9' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
8' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
6' A spell of possession for Heidenheim in an attempt to control the game.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mainz will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will referee today's match.
